nom: RoC Hydration+ Line Plumping Face Serum Stick

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one describing skin as 'extremely dry' or 'super dry face and neck,' report the stick relieves tightness and leaves skin soft and hydrated without greasy residue.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive report the fragrance-free formula is gentle, including around the eyes, with no irritation noted.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports being able to apply the product only where needed, preventing chapping in cold weather.
segments.mature: Reviewers referencing aging or mature skin report visible softening of fine lines and firmer, smoother-looking skin with regular use.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report reduced appearance of fine lines, plumping, and smoother texture, some noting visible change within a week to a month; a few say they saw little to no improvement in fine lines, especially on the forehead, or have not used it long enough to judge.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report immediate and lasting hydration, describing skin as plumper, softer, and more comfortable through the day and in cold weather.
concerns.redness: No reviewers specifically discuss redness reduction or irritation-related redness with this product.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers reference chapping or flakiness prevention in cold weather, but none discuss barrier repair explicitly.
concerns.spots: No reviewer discusses dark spots or hyperpigmentation.
concerns.blemishes: No reviewer discusses acne or blemishes with this product.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say the product is not greasy and does not add oiliness; none report it controlling excess oil.

aspects.libelle: Fragrance pleasant to some, off-putting to others
Thick, waxy film feel on skin

extraits.texte: While it is hydrating the consistency of what was left on my face was like candle wax or stick deodorant.

I have dry yet sensitive skin, so it's difficult to find products that work for me. I love the way the slides on my face and leaves it feeling softer and more hydrated. I haven't been using it long enough to speak to it effect on fine lines around my eyes, but I will continue to use it because it really softens and moisturize my after dry face.

The RoC Hydration+ Serum Stick hydrates my skin and reduces wrinkles. I have been using this hydrating and serum stick for almost a month. I have very dry skin on my face and beginning to show signs of wrinkles. Since using this product, I have noticed that my skin has become more hydrated and reduced signs of wrinkles. I use it every day on my face and neck. I haven't seen or used a product that shows results this fast. I highly recommend this product to others who are looking for a hydrating and serum stick to help improve their skin. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

I am so thankful to PINCHme for sending me a full-size RoC Hydration+ Serum Stick! I've been using it for about a month and the positive results I'm noticing are impressive - I definitely see both reduction in fine lines and smoother-looking skin. It also provides lasting hydration, which is great for the cold months. The stick is great and super convenient, easy to use and mess-free. I also like that it is fragrance-free, which is great for the sensitive skin on my face. Definitely would recommend!

This RoC Hydration+ Serum Stick is exactly what my dry skin needed. My skin felt instantly hydrated immediately upon application. After several uses my skin felt plumper and softer and I really felt like it helped to smooth my fine lines especially in the eye area. It's stick format is also super easy to use and apply. This is overall a really great product.

I received the ROC hydration stick from pinchme in exchange for an honest review. I loved how smooth and cooling this went on . I have combination skin so it's great to be able to just apply it where it's needed . This prevents my skin from getting chapped in the cold weather and is very moisturizing and gentle.

My body absolutely loved this serum stick! It left my extremely dry skin feeling soft and hydrated without leaving a greasy residue behind like some other products tend to do! Would definitely recommend it! I received this product free for review from Pinchme!
